items.title: One of Google’s Android partners turned 1.3 million set-top boxes into a botnet
items.summary: Google says one of its Android manufacturing partners secretly built a backdoor in 1.3 million devices and turned them into a botnet. The company says it has now dismantled the backdoor and "cut ties"…

items.summary: BMW says that it will expand its navigation-guided, partially automated driving capabilities into urban environments starting in 2027, launching first in Germany with other markets to follow. The new…

items.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
items.summary: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.

items.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
items.summary: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.
